title: Velvety Roasted Saudi Arabian Tuna Kebabs
description: A crowd-pleasing Saudi Arabian dish featuring roasted tuna, this recipe is a silky and savory delight, perfect for special occasions, and is shojin-friendly as it does not contain any animal products except for the tuna.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the tuna steaks to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated tuna onto skewers, if using wooden skewers, soak them in water for 30 minutes before threading.
Place the tuna kebabs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the tuna kebabs in the preheated oven for 12 minutes.
Remove the tuna kebabs from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the tuna kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
